evidence_quotes: The Exam Validity Extension Program (EVEP) provides an opportunity for registered representatives and investment adviser representatives to extend their state qualification exams.
This program allows industry professionals to maintain their state qualification exams for up to five years if they maintain compliance with their continuing education requirements.
An oral proceeding is not scheduled on this rule.
An oral proceeding must be held if a written request for an oral proceeding is submitted by a political subdivision, an agency or ten (10) or more persons.
